# Forbes

> Forbes is a global media hub delivering breaking business news, investment insights, political coverage, and leadership analysis for executives and entrepreneurs.

Forbes provides comprehensive coverage of business, finance, technology, and politics, with specialized tracking of major political figures and trending topics. The site combines news aggregation with original reporting and interactive content.

## Key Topics

- Business News
- Trump Administration
- Politics
- Finance & Investing
- Entrepreneurship
- Technology
- Breaking News
- Tax Policy
- AI & Emerging Tech
- Leadership
- Government Agencies
- Market Analysis
- Trending Articles

## Core News & Breaking Coverage

- [Forbes Homepage](https://www.forbes.com): Forbes homepage: global media hub for business, investing, tech, and leadership news
- [Breaking News](https://www.forbes.com/news): Forbes breaking news hub: latest stories on politics, business, science, and justice
- [Forbes Daily Cover Stories](https://www.forbes.com/daily-cover-stories): Daily cover stories: Forbes featured articles on business, finance, and entrepreneurship

## Political Coverage & Government

- [Trump Tracker](https://www.forbes.com/trump): Trump Tracker: Forbes coverage of Trump administration, politics, and related news

## Games & Interactive Content

- [Forbes Games](https://www.forbes.com/games): Forbes Games collection: free word games, crosswords, puzzles, and trivia
